citation.authors: Moller H, Henson K, Luchtenborg M, Broggio J et al

cited_by.title: Breast cancer, triple-negative disease and screening

record.population: 86,852 women with breast cancer diagnosed in England 2012-2013
record.design: National cancer-registry cohort, Cox models for two-year death
record.finding: Triple-negative cancers had an adjusted hazard ratio for death of 2.00 (95% CI 1.84-2.17). Black women had an age-adjusted hazard ratio of 1.77 (1.48-2.13) against White women. The authors say the excess mortality has contributions from socio-economic factors, stage distribution and tumour biology.
record.note: Two-year deaths only; one author was formerly employed by BUPA and two received HCA International funding for unrelated work.
